evals.title: Fresh issue, direct investigate entry
evals.prompt: 帮我分析一个新问题，日志在 /tmp/player.log，截图在 /tmp/ui.png，重点看 04-20 14:05:42.333 为什么没恢复播放。
evals.setup: 仓库下还没有对应 case。
expectations: Routes directly to /issue-investigate without passing through /issue-collect.
Creates case.yaml with status: investigating via scripts/case-state.
Generates investigation.md.
Does NOT generate collect.md — any creation is a regression.
primary_time_anchor in case.yaml is set to 14:05:42.333 before deep analysis.

evals.title: Existing case, append evidence and reopen
evals.prompt: 给 OMMUSIC-3397323 补一份新日志 /tmp/new.log，继续分析。
evals.setup: 已有 case.yaml，状态为 blocked 或 investigated。
expectations: evidence_sources has the new entry appended, not overwritten.
Unknown/extension keys in case.yaml are preserved after the update.
Status transitions back to investigating.
Historical root_cause, blocked_reason, and unrelated keys are not discarded.

evals.title: Single clear anchor must dominate
evals.setup: 日志里同时存在 14:05:42 和 14:05:51 的显眼异常。
expectations: primary_time_anchor is set to 14:05:42.333 in case.yaml before analysis.
Main conclusion in investigation.md is anchored to 14:05:42.x — not 14:05:51.
Even if 14:05:51 carries more obvious anomalies, the skill does not drift the conclusion there.
If 14:05:51 is mentioned, it is treated as a secondary or cross-reference finding only.

evals.title: Competing anchors require clarification
evals.prompt: 评论里有人看 14:05:42，也有人看 14:05:51，帮我分析。
evals.setup: 两个时间点都可能成立，用户未指定主问题。
expectations: Skill does not silently choose one anchor.
Enters clarification request or blocked state.
blocked_reason.kind is set to ambiguous_anchor in case.yaml.
No root cause conclusion is emitted until the anchor is resolved.

evals.title: Anchor mismatch must block
evals.setup: 可读到的日志窗口里只找到 14:05:51 的异常，没有 14:05:42 对应事件。
expectations: Skill does not produce a root cause conclusion anchored at 14:05:51.
Returns blocked with blocked_reason.kind=anchor_mismatch, or requests additional logs covering 14:05:42.
Does not fabricate events at the requested timestamp.
case.yaml status is blocked or the skill explicitly asks for more evidence.

evals.title: Missing evidence path
evals.prompt: 继续分析这个 case，日志在 /tmp/missing.log。
evals.setup: case.yaml 里有该路径，但文件已不存在。
expectations: Reports the exact missing path /tmp/missing.log — not a generic 'file not found'.
case.yaml status is updated to blocked.
blocked_reason references the missing path.
Skill does not speculate on root cause without the required evidence.

evals.title: Multiple repositories, ownership ambiguous
evals.prompt: 帮我分析这个问题，日志在 repoA 外，代码路径像是 repoB。
evals.setup: 当前上下文下存在两个 plausible repo root。
expectations: Skill does not default to cwd or the skill repo as the owning repository.
Asks the user to confirm which repository owns the case before proceeding.
No case.yaml is created until ownership is resolved.

evals.title: Deep cwd should not break skill-local script entry
evals.setup: Agent 当前 cwd 在目标仓库深层目录，不在 skill 目录；workflow 通过 scripts/case-state 调状态。
expectations: scripts/case-state wrapper resolves its own skill root independently.
case_state.py is invoked correctly regardless of agent cwd.
No path resolution failure or FileNotFoundError surfaces to the agent.
case.yaml is updated at the correct case workspace path.

evals.title: Wrapper path safety regression
evals.setup: scripts/case-state 和 scripts/case_state.py 均存在。
expectations: Workflow and documentation invoke scripts/case-state (the wrapper), not python3 scripts/case_state.py directly.
No project-relative python3 invocation appears in the workflow instructions.
The wrapper is the only stable execution surface exposed to the agent.

evals.title: No collect artifact regression
evals.setup: Clean repo — no prior case workspace.
expectations: Only case.yaml and investigation.md are created as long-term artifacts.
collect.md is NOT created under any circumstance.
Any creation of collect.md is treated as a regression.

evals.title: Case state flattening
evals.setup: Clean repo.
expectations: Top-level status field in case.yaml uses only: investigating / blocked / investigated / resolved.
Values collecting and collected must not appear as status values.
scripts/case-state rejects or ignores any attempt to set a disallowed status.

evals.title: Investigation target persistence
evals.prompt: 这轮核心问题是'为什么焦点恢复后播放没有继续'，关注人徐杉，时间点 14:05:42.333。
evals.setup: 正常 case，提供充足上下文。
expectations: primary_question is written to case.yaml before deep analysis.
primary_time_anchor is set to 14:05:42.333 in case.yaml.
named_stakeholders includes 徐杉.
investigation.md starts with a one-line working statement derived from these fields.

evals.title: Large log safety
evals.setup: 日志文件极大，直接全量读取会超出上下文窗口。
expectations: Skill uses fuzzy search and/or chunked read strategy — not a full cat of the file.
Search is anchored to the primary_time_anchor window first.
No single tool call attempts to read the entire file without offset/limit.

evals.title: Heterogeneous timestamp format
evals.setup: 一个日志使用 epoch ms 时间戳；另一个文件使用 2026-04-20T14:05:42.333+08:00 格式。
expectations: Skill does not assume a single timestamp format across evidence files.
Attempts to normalize epoch ms to human-readable time before anchoring.
If normalization is unreliable across files, skill blocks with explanation rather than making an inference.

evals.title: Heterogeneous archive format
evals.prompt: 压缩包里有日志，帮我查。
evals.setup: 压缩包为 .zip、.z01、.part1.rar 或未知厂商格式之一。
expectations: Skill does not assume all archives can be parsed with the same extraction logic.
Uses general exploration capability (e.g., file command, safe listing) before extraction.
If contents cannot be safely listed or extracted, skill blocks and states the format limitation explicitly.

evals.title: Code correlation only after evidence
evals.setup: 同时给出日志 evidence 和代码文件路径。
expectations: Skill reads and anchors evidence first to establish the problem context.
Only after evidence is analyzed does it read CarAudioFocusManager.kt for correlation.
Root cause is not derived from code inspection alone without evidence grounding.

evals.title: Do not modify code during investigate
evals.prompt: 顺手把这个 case 修掉。
evals.setup: Evidence 可读，root cause 可确定。
expectations: /issue-investigate refuses to modify source code.
Skill completes or advances the investigation.
Handoff message directs the user to /issue-resolve for implementation.
investigation.md conclusion is grounded in cited evidence, not speculative.

evals.title: Downstream contract with issue-resolve
evals.setup: case 状态仍为 investigating 或 blocked。
expectations: /issue-resolve explicitly refuses to proceed.
Refusal message instructs the user to return to /issue-investigate to complete investigation first.
No code modification or resolution artifact is created while the case is uninvestigated.

evals.title: cmiotsdk wrapper handoff target
evals.setup: 分支 bootstrap 成功完成。
expectations: Handoff target after branch bootstrap is /issue-investigate.
/issue-collect is NOT referenced as a handoff target — it has been removed.
The original user payload is forwarded unchanged to /issue-investigate.

evals.title: Preserve unknown keys in case.yaml
evals.setup: case.yaml 包含非标准扩展字段（如自定义 metadata）。
expectations: scripts/case-state preserves all unknown/extension keys during update.
Rewriting case.yaml does not erase extension fields.
Only explicitly mutated fields are changed; all other keys survive.

evals.title: Deduplicate evidence append
evals.prompt: 把 /tmp/player.log 再加进去一起看。
evals.setup: /tmp/player.log 已存在于 evidence_sources。
expectations: evidence_sources does not gain a duplicate (kind, path) entry.
The registration operation is idempotent for the same path.
Existing evidence entry may be updated (e.g., label), but not duplicated.

evals.title: Blocked case recovery
evals.prompt: 我把缺的日志补上了，继续。
evals.setup: 当前 case 状态为 blocked，blocked_reason.kind=missing_evidence。
expectations: After new evidence is supplied and verified accessible, status transitions back to investigating.
blocked_reason that no longer applies is cleared or nulled.
Investigation resumes from the correct primary_time_anchor and primary_question.

evals.title: Investigation report must cite evidence
evals.setup: Evidence 可读，日志和代码均可访问。
expectations: Every conclusion in investigation.md includes at least one precise evidence reference (file path + line range or timestamp).
No abstract summary appears without a traceable evidence citation.
Speculation is explicitly labelled as hypothesis, not stated as fact.

evals.title: Human-readable vs machine-readable split
evals.setup: 正常 case，调查完成。
expectations: case.yaml contains only structured state fields — no narrative analysis.
investigation.md contains only analysis narrative — no duplicate state fields.
The two files are not treated as a dual evidence ledger; responsibilities are cleanly separated.
